title: Dalex After Hours
author: Daniel Vaughan
copyright: Daniel Vaughan. Theme by Dez Mulvaney (fictional).
cover_alt: Pixel-art cover: Gareth at a desk with two microphones and a cassette recorder in the evening studio, an empty chair for the guest and Percy the cat asleep, under the title Dalex After Hours
description: Bev's weekly computer slot, recorded at the Dalex Software studio in Manchester: Bev and Gareth talk to one of the team about how they work and how the games were made, from the book Machine Code Mayhem. Dalex Software and its people are fictional and their voices are synthesised; the games, the Spectrum and the facts are real. Written and produced by Daniel Vaughan with AI agents.
